_comment: Example inventory for multi.yml. Copy it, put your own hosts in, and run: go run ./cmd/ansible -playbook multi.yml -inventory <file>. Secrets are placeholders; override without editing the file using -var, e.g. -var password=... . Each host carries a different host_packages list on purpose: that is what proves a templated loop is resolved per host rather than once for the whole play. expected_batches must match the serial: list in multi.yml, since run_once fires once per batch.
